_about: Public-domain Henry Kollock (1778-1819), Presbyterian minister of the Independent Presbyterian Church, Savannah, for the Word Hoard: Sermons on Various Subjects (Savannah, 1811) and his posthumous Sermons (London, 1871). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 90 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
